text.title: FreshDrop app, slot reminder release, 14 screens
text.s1: Home: «Book a slot» button, slot list, new
text.s2: Slot picker: day and time grid, existing
text.s5: Order summary: slot, total, pay, existing
text.scenario: The buyer sets a reminder for a booked slot, from the slot picker to the confirmation toast
text.change: Added: reminder settings screen. Changed: home gets a «Book a slot» button. Nothing removed
text.transitions: Home → Slot picker (user taps «Book a slot»); Slot picker → Reminder settings (user toggles the reminder); Reminder settings → Order summary (system saves and returns)
text.states: Slot picker: skeleton while loading, «no slots» empty state; Address check: full-screen error when the address is out of the zone
text.affected: Push service (notifications team) sends the reminder; the courier app is out of scope
text.decision: Reminder kept as a separate screen, not a modal: it is reused from the order page; day and time pickers merged into one
text.check: Click-test on 6 buyers: all 6 set the reminder without help; time-to-set not measured, only success
